description: Columbus, MS — In case you missed it, as reported by Mississippi Today’s Taylor Vance, U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks (D-MD) spent Saturday campaigning with District Attorney Scott Colom in Jackson, joining him on the trail to highlight the healthcare fight driving Mississippi's Senate race that is drawing growing national attention.
